newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip's North Sea Thelma field starts up.
newsitem.headline: Agip's North Sea Thelma field starts up.

text.p: Italian Agip Spa said its Agip U.K. unit has started oil production from the Thelma field in the North Sea some two months ahead of schedule.

Agip U.K. operates in the Block 16/17 with a 47.48 percent stake of a consortium which includes Petrofina (30 percent), Louisiana Land and Exploration Co's U.K. unit (11.26 percent) and Murphy Oil Corp (11.26 percent).
The Thelma fields are situated about 12 km south of the Tiffany platform.

Agip, the oil and gas arm of state-controlled energy group ENI, said in statement that recoverable reserves from the Thelma fields were estimated at 45 million barrels per day of oil and condensates and about 1.5 billion cubic metres of natural gas.
